take_homes: The agent's review of its own work can't be trusted. Check it yourself or get a second reader with no history.
Where the agent has gaps it fills them with plausible generic guesses, so name what's missing and never accept a filled-in blank.
Have it show a plan and approve it before it writes any files. Keep what worked in a rules file it re-reads.

monday.move: Ask my controller to try the month-end variance commentary with an agent once, plan-first, and check the numbers against our own report by hand.
monday.stop_condition: Stop if any number can't be tied to the ledger, or if IT says the tool isn't approved for finance data.
monday.blocker: IT has not approved the tool for finance data.

misconception.why: I never saw a cost, a payback or what it takes to build this across the organisation, only a personal website. I still read it as a licence we buy. The 'rules file that compounds' hints at capability, but nothing showed the organisation building it.

one_line: The look-back and plan-first parts were useful, but it kept repeating the same filler paragraph and used a personal website exercise, and I never saw a cost figure.
